arguments.rationale: AMP-activated protein kinase is the entity whose activity is explicitly activated.
The title makes aglycon the subject that induces apoptosis via the anchored kinase activation.

direction.rationale: Activation lexically states an increase from inactive or lower activity to active kinase activity.

comparison.rationale: The context states activation but provides no explicit comparison between groups or values.

polarity.rationale: The event is presented as part of an affirmative causal mechanism, with no negation or null result.

uncertainty.rationale: The title states the activation mechanism without hedging or hypothesis language.

statistics.rationale: No p-value, confidence interval, effect estimate, or explicit significance interpretation appears in the permitted context.

permitted_contextual_participants.rationale: This exact cell population explicitly scopes where the activation mechanism occurs.

cases.overall_rationale: The title asserts that aglycon activates AMPK as part of an apoptosis mechanism in HT-29 colon cancer cells; the activation is directional but not an explicit between-group comparison.

arguments.rationale: Osteonectin is the gene product whose expression is the stated object of investigation.

direction.rationale: Expression is explicitly examined, but this sentence does not state that its level increased or decreased.

comparison.rationale: No explicit comparative relation or comparator is present in the permitted context.

polarity.rationale: The investigation of expression is affirmatively reported and is not an analytic null result.

uncertainty.rationale: The expression event is framed as the object of investigation rather than as a stated biological result, making the event-level judgment provisional.

statistics.rationale: The permitted sentence contains no explicit statistical observation or author significance interpretation.

mention.text: fresh BALB/c fibroblasts transformed by v-Ki-ras

permitted_contextual_participants.rationale: The full explicit cell-population mention scopes the osteonectin expression under investigation without assigning v-Ki-ras an unexpressed causal role in that expression.

cases.overall_rationale: The sentence reports a study of osteonectin expression in a defined transformed fibroblast population, without giving an expression direction, comparison, or result statistic.

arguments.rationale: Tumor is the entity undergoing the anchored progression.

direction.rationale: Progression lexically denotes forward advancement of the tumor process rather than stasis or decrease.

comparison.rationale: The nominal progression mention contains directional meaning but no explicit comparator or comparative measurement.

polarity.rationale: Tumor progression is used affirmatively as the biological context governed by the discussed mechanisms.

evidence.text: Recent advances have fostered a more detailed understanding

uncertainty.rationale: The sentence makes an unhedged statement about understanding mechanisms in tumor progression.

statistics.rationale: No explicit statistical observation or significance interpretation occurs in the permitted context.

cases.overall_rationale: The context uses tumor progression as an affirmed, lexically advancing process; EMT is another biological process, not an allowed contextual entity participant for this anchored event.

arguments.rationale: EGF-R is one of the proteins whose abundance is explicitly described as increased.

direction.rationale: The source explicitly states increased protein abundance.

comparison.rationale: Increased abundance explicitly denotes a greater amount relative to an implicit reference abundance.

polarity.rationale: The increased-abundance state is presented affirmatively as detectable, with no negation or null finding.

uncertainty.rationale: The abundance event itself is unhedged; the later modal 'can provide' concerns prognostic information, not whether abundance is increased.

statistics.rationale: The permitted context contains no p-value, confidence interval, effect estimate, or explicit significance statement.

permitted_contextual_participants.rationale: This coordinated protein mention is explicitly governed by the same increased-abundance phrase as EGF-R.
The source explicitly locates the increased protein abundance in this tumor population.

cases.overall_rationale: The context affirms greater abundance of either EGF-R or Her-2/neu proteins in human tumors; its claim about possible prognostic utility does not hedge the abundance event itself.

arguments.rationale: The glucose transporters are the entities whose expression is being regulated.

direction.rationale: Regulation of expression is explicit, but the sentence does not specify whether transporter expression rises or falls.

comparison.rationale: No comparison of transporter expression levels is stated.

polarity.rationale: Expression regulation is presented affirmatively as the proposed mechanism, not negated and not as a null result.

uncertainty.rationale: The permitted sentence frames the compound's ability and mechanism as what the study examined rather than reporting a completed expression-level result.

statistics.rationale: There is no explicit statistical observation or significance interpretation in the permitted sentence.

permitted_contextual_participants.rationale: The purine analogue is explicitly the agent whose ability to regulate transporter expression is examined.
Reduced glucose consumption is the explicit downstream outcome linked to regulation of transporter localization and expression.

cases.overall_rationale: The sentence provisionally frames 8-aminoadenosine as regulating transporter expression in a mechanism leading to reduced glucose consumption, while leaving the direction of expression itself unstated.

arguments.rationale: Tumour is the entity subjected to the anchored inhibition.

uncertainty.rationale: The source reports the activity as a demonstrated study finding without hedging.

statistics.rationale: No p-value, confidence interval, effect estimate, or significance interpretation is stated in this permitted sentence.

arguments.rationale: CDC4/FBXW7 is the biological object whose role the methods assessed; the sentence does not yet establish it as a causal agent.
Gastric cancer is the explicit disease context in which the gene's role was assessed.

direction.rationale: An assessed role is not itself an increased, decreased, enabling, or observed biological quantity.

comparison.rationale: The methods statement contains no explicit comparative judgment about the role.

polarity.rationale: The assessment is affirmatively reported and is not a negated or null analytic finding.

uncertainty.rationale: This METHODS sentence identifies the role as a question under assessment rather than asserting the gene's disease role as a result.

statistics.rationale: The permitted METHODS context has a sample count but no allowed effect estimate, p-value, confidence interval, or author significance interpretation.

cases.overall_rationale: The passage is a methods description of assessing CDC4/FBXW7 in gastric cancer. LOH and MLPA are analytic targets or assays, while the detailed carcinoma mentions are study samples, so none is added as a participant of the anchored role event.
